{{Quote|May I bring you a drink?''"<br />"''Sonic Screwdriver.|A protocol droid and Drikl Lecersen|<ref name="Con" />}}
The '''Sonic Screwdriver''' was an [[Alcohol/Legends|alcoholic]] [[Cocktail/Legends|cocktail]] composed of [[Fruit/Legends|fruit]] juice and [[Liquor/Legends|liquor]] that was widely available across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="Con" /> In [[44 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Conviction]]'' to [[44 ABY]].</ref> the drink's textbook recipe was replicated precisely by a [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] when the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Drikl Lecersen]] ordered a Sonic Screwdriver while in [[Obridagar's Simulator Palace]], a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] training facility on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="Con" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Yes, the Dr. Who call-out was deliberate. Yet invisile ''[sic]'' to those unfamiliar with Dr. Who. The best sort of in-joke.|Aaron Allston|<ref name="DrWho">{{Twitter|aaronallston|status/223131070659440640|Aaron Allston|quote=@lethargilistic - Yes, the Dr. Who call-out was deliberate. Yet invisile to those unfamiliar with Dr. Who. The best sort of in-joke.|date=2012-07-11|archivedate=20200814200630}}</ref>}}
The Sonic Screwdriver appeared in ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Conviction]]'', a [[2011]] novel by [[Aaron Allston]].<ref name="Con" /> Allston borrowed the name "sonic screwdriver" from the [[Wikipedia:Sonic screwdriver|all-purpose tool]] used by [[Wikipedia:Doctor (Doctor Who)|the Doctor]] in [[Wikipedia:Doctor Who|''Doctor Who'']].<ref name="DrWho" />
